title: Collect What You Can
prompt: Implement async def gather_all(jobs) where jobs are coroutines that may raise. Use asyncio.gather(..., return_exceptions=True) and return (successes, failures): successes is the list of non-exception results in order; failures is the list of exception instances in order. Provide sync wrapper run_collect(jobs).
boilerplate:
import asyncio

async def gather_all(jobs):
    pass

def run_collect(jobs):
    pass

tests.name: separates results from failures
tests.code:
async def ok():
    return 1
async def bad():
    raise ValueError('x')
succ, fail = run_collect([ok(), bad(), ok()])
assert succ == [1, 1]
assert len(fail) == 1 and isinstance(fail[0], ValueError)
tests.hint: return_exceptions=True turns errors into values to partition.

tests.name: empty input
tests.hint: Nothing in, nothing out — both empty.
